title: Ölüme Fısıldayan Adam
author: Büşra Yılmaz
description: Born from the ashes of pain, The Man Who Whispered to Death introduces two fractured souls brought together by fate. He is a brilliant con artist who has learned to survive by burning; living, loving, and destroying himself in the process. She is a girl who has never truly lived, estranged from life itself, unable even to master death. Like a butterfly lost inside a beehive and a fish afraid of water, they are drawn to one another as if designed to be each other’s cure. But what happens when a butterfly, meant to live for only a day, dares to fall in love with tomorrow?
